prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Grey rain clouds breaking apart above a green hillside with shafts of sunlight coming through, a family in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, looking up at the sky with their backs to the camera. Rain clearing, shafts of sunlight. Expectant. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
